report.explanation: Alert claims checkout health degraded, but current telemetry is largely healthy: order checkout trace OK (62ms), gateway/order/payment error_rate 0.001, p95 74ms, no timeouts or pool waiters. Only inventory shows anomalies (configuration_rejections=14, error_rate=0.1), but no evidence ties it to checkout. Order deployment 3.3.5 is 495 min old and valid; deployment record cannot establish latency causation. Insufficient evidence for a bounded root cause; hand off.
missing_evidence: Inventory configuration_rejections=14 and error_rate=0.1: need inventory logs/traces to confirm bad-configuration as the checkout-degrading cause
Need evidence linking inventory errors to checkout failures (order traces show only one OK span, no downstream error)
Need inventory deployment/config change records to establish a configuration fault rather than transient rejections
